newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: India tenders to buy July crude oil -- traders.
newsitem.headline: India tenders to buy July crude oil -- traders.

text.p: State-owned Indian Oil Corp (IOC) has issued a tender to buy one million barrels of July crude oil, traders said.
The tender closes May 27 and offers should be valid until 2200 hours (1630 GMT) on May 29.
The IOC is seeking a range of crude from Europe, Middle East, West Africa and Asia, the traders said.
In its June buying tender, India awarded three cargoes of Dubai crude, two very large crude carriers (VLCC) of West African Qua Iboe, and one VLCC of Suez Blend.
